[h2]Greetings, Commanders![/h2]

How have you been? On our side it's pretty much as always - hard at work, adding new stuff, improving old and fixing things that weren't intended to happen in the first place. We've been continuously working on Zoria not only up to its launch, but also after it came out. Guided by your thoughts, comments, reviews and suggestions, we pushed update after update to reach Zoria's full potential. Honestly? What we come with today feels like a new era for our game. It's not the same title as it's been on March 7th. But, before we move on, make sure to reach the end of the article - there's a message from our publisher who has some really great news for you 😃

So, without further ado, let's jump into the update. [b]Here are the most significant changes that we implemented since Zoria's launch back in March:[/b]

notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Commanders![/h2]

[h2]Patch 1.0.4[/h2]
[h3]📌 Scene changes [/h3]
Rithvale Area
⚔️ fixed a few environmental issues with floating objects;
⚔️ Ruvan Village Elder NPC renamed to reflect her name;
⚔️ fixed Commoner pathing;
⚔️ disabled warning in the Effigy creature’s area when leaving for Thonargond;
⚔️ graverobbers are now appearing as intended during the quest and not before;
⚔️ Removed the Elder of Ruvan from the day-night timetable, to make her accessible at all times;
⚔️ Update Dragon to level 10 and updated some of its stats to make the fight more relevant.
Rithvale Outpost
⚔️ fixed double Old-Bean Truff NPC.
Rithvale Keep
⚔️ fixed Level 2 upgrade wall that was missing collision;
⚔️ added missing outline to NPC.
Daeg Marastir
⚔️ fixed an issue that was preventing the Combat Tutorial to trigger;
⚔️ streamlined the flow, removed some fights, adjusted damage and hit points for enemies to make the area easier to navigate for new players. 
Yarnigan Mine
⚔️ fixed an edge case where, if you did not deliver “Lost Miners” quest but delivered “Ther Mine” quest you would be locked out of delivering “Lost Miners” as the NPC will disappear. 
Forest of Nurdundas 
⚔️ added a new merchant. 
The Shrieking Pass
⚔️ Gerwin is now properly recruited. 
Bilnaram Hills
⚔️ Added info on the map regarding Wizard being necessary for Bilnaram Cellar 
Thonargond
⚔️ fixed an issue with the dome being accessible in a certain area. 
Grimwood Crypt
⚔️ Improved rooftop hide event near certain buildings. 
Thonargond Citadel, Thonargond Seat of Ancestors 
⚔️ Fixed level of pickup gear recipes from auto Level to Level 14 

[h3]📌 Game-wide changes[/h3] 
⚔️ Increase Physical/Magical Damage Weapon stats for 2 handed items (from 1.5x to 2.5x versus one handed items) 
⚔️ Merchant System – Fixed option to Buy/Sell recipes (gear, cooking, alchemy) 
⚔️ Quest Marks – fixed issue with color of quest mark (yellow instead of blue) when a merchant had also a rumor entry. 
⚔️ Changed default level of audio settings to match the reset values. 
⚔️ World Shrines that buff Stamina will now give the corresponding HP as well. 
⚔️ Added missing Voice Over for Amaldir.
⚔️ Added Priestess of Amaldir world shrines in multiple areas that clear Curses and Diseases. 
⚔️ Multiple typos are fixed in quest entries, UI and game story/lore. 

[h3]📌 Class Changes [/h3]
⚔️ Sentinel Class - increase damage for Backbreaker, Vigilant Strike, Igniting Blade. Banner of Might will give a buff on 20% Intellect as well beside Agility and Strength 
⚔️ Kingsman Class - increased damage for some abilities and increased range for King's Fire ability 
⚔️ Necromancer Class - increased damage and reduced cost for certain abilities. Infernal Edict damage and hit points adjusted 
⚔️ Priest - Healing Well is now placed next in the Combat Queue thus providing the healing effect right after the end of turn of the current Priest character.

[h1]Hello, Commanders![/h1]

Before we get to the changelog, let's share with you the latest decision we made.

[h2]Important Announcement[/h2]

[b]Due to the congested September release schedule, we chose to delay the release date of Zoria.[/b] Titles such as Baldur's Gate 3, Starfield, and Lies of P, to name just a few, release around the same period. While some of you have pointed it out as we announced our release date, we couldn't put Zoria, an indie game, and other AAA production titles, in the same league (but thanks to those of you who did, we took it as a huge compliment!). Long story short, we feel that shifting our release date would give Zoria the attention and exposure it deserves.

That said, we settled that [b]October 5th[/b] will be the best day to release Zoria: Age of Shattering. It's just a few days later than our initial release date, but we believe this time will provide a space between releases needed for Zoria to shine through. ☀️ Additionally, since every single day at this point will be extremely precious, it will give us extra time to polish the game.

notes.notes:

We're excited to share the latest update for Zoria: Age of Shattering. Our team has been working non-stop to bring you changes and improvements that'll make your gaming experience even better. [h2]Camera and Controls  [/h2]
The camera will now have a [b]smoother motion[/b] and [b]auto-rotation[/b] toward the movement direction. Plus, we've added[b] alternative keyboard movement[/b] controls for those who prefer this control style to the mouse-click-only control. The camera collision system will work better now, and a new see-through camera obstruction feature will ensure an unobstructed view.  

Trees will no longer block your view! They will now disappear and won't block your sight 🌲👀

Armor changes will be visible on the 3D models of the main character and followers! We've also [b]categorized current armor sets[/b] into Light, Medium, Hardened, and Heavy, as well as by rarity: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Exotic, and Epic. We'll add even more armor designs in future updates.

notes.title: Time to make friends and put on shiny armor. Monthly Changelog #4
notes.notes:
[h1]Commanders! ⚔️  [/h1]

We are slowly getting to the point where we're polishing the game and getting it ready for you to play 🤫 This month we were not only ticking off things from our "to-do list" but also working closely with [b]playtesters [/b]and polishing the game based on their [b]reactions [/b]and [b]feedback[/b].   

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/0a407404f9d5762f805bd3061ee430b68ec65e67.jpg[/img]  

Anyway, what's changed outside of typical [b]bug fixing[/b], [b]UI adjusting[/b], and [b]polishing [/b]already implemented features?  

[h2]Upgraded party's downtime  [/h2]

We want the resting mechanic to play an important role in Zoria's gameplay. On the one hand, because of the [b]strategic point of view[/b] and how it benefits the party. The player can organize camps to [b]heal wounded followers[/b] or [b]exchange them for new ones[/b]. On the other hand, because of the [b]bonds the player can establish[/b] with various characters.   

Since Zoria is a roleplaying game, we implemented a dialogue system during the rest, enabling the player to [b]learn more about the followers they're traveling with[/b], get to know them better, and decide who they like best.  

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/4ded41b97749d04907cef7d2b93446f58ef5345c.png[/img]

Moreover, we designed some quests that can be triggered by setting up the camp, so [b]beware[/b]! It could be wildlife or bandits attacking or a follower coming up to you and saying, "we need to talk." It's hard to say which one is worse 😬  

[h2]A more dynamic camera during dialogue  [/h2]

Some quest dialogue would benefit from more dynamic camera action. We [b]improved close-ups[/b] to make it look and feel better 😜   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/fcc86497c5493069241ae64e206919e926847cde.png[/img]

[h2]Follower's status changes when they're not an active member of the party  [/h2]

The game treats the follower as an NPC unless they get recruited to the party. The player can interact with NPC followers and see them roaming in the world when they're [b]out of duty[/b]. Additionally, followers' models will [b]respond in real-time[/b] to the player changing their [b]gear [/b]and [b]weapons[/b].   

[h2]New equipment  [/h2]

Speaking of which, we got our characters some [b]new armor and equipment[/b] designs! We're integrating them with the character creator to give players more options to customize their hero. We're still planning on adding even more armor in the future, not only for fashion's sake 😉   

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/8213cde3c5c5d96a2bec6f97db5188559ea14b27.png[/img]

There is some exciting news coming soon 😉 Stay tuned!

notes.title: What's new in the world of Zoria? Monthly changelog.
notes.notes:
Hello commanders! 

It has been approximately six weeks since our Kickstarter campaign, and throughout this period, we have been tirelessly working to bring you a game that guarantees a remarkable experience. Today, we are excited to present a sneak peek of our current development progress through a collection of fresh screenshots. We sincerely hope you enjoy them and that they heighten your anticipation for what's to come!

However, before we delve into the main content, we kindly request your support by voting for Zoria in the IndieDB's Indie of the Year poll. With a vast community like yours, we firmly believe that we can secure a prominent position in this competition dedicated to indie game enthusiasts.

[url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/zoria-age-of-shattering][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/070d9a93bf60633e767eed8a809110243b4bbfd7.jpg[/img][/url]

You can cast a vote on our IndieDB page [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/zoria-age-of-shattering]>>here<< [/url]

[b]Now, let's move on with the changelog.[/b]

[b][h3]Nightwarden Class[/h3][/b]
As some of you may recall, one of the secret goals of the Kickstarter campaign was reaching 50%, and it unlocked a new class - [b]fearless and violent Nightwarden[/b]. First, we had some rough ideas on how this class should act on the battlefield, and during the last month, we managed to finish the profile of this class.

Nightwardens [b]will use fire [/b]on the battlefield because this is the most effective deterring of monsters. Having Nightwarden in your team will significantly increase the group morale, as [b]Nightwardens fear no death[/b] and can teach their teammates how to act the same. On top of that, Nightwardens know that the night is short; therefore, [b]they must act quickly. [/b]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Tbwhbsn/Sequence-01.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Day-night cycle[/h3][/b]
Well, what would be the point of the existence of Nightwardens if there were no night, wasn't it? That's why we've been spending the last few weeks polishing the day and night cycle in the world of Zoria, which will not only limit the amount of sunlight but also [b]affect certain events and behaviors at specific times of the day.[/b] 

And remember, the world of Zoria is not a safe enough place during the day. I dread to think how it will be at night. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/93915a48baa4f2479e17f23caf1e3c518aa83b44.png[/img]

[b][h3]Lake Mannor[/h3][/b]
A castle in the middle of rocky mountains, a fisherman's hut, fog hovering over the lake, and rumors of a secret lurking beneath the surface of this reservoir. [b]Don't forget to chat with a hunter [/b]who stays in the area, as he will have something to say about the place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/be8af7db7561bac19c67085c8531cdf6aea06404.png[/img]

[b][h3]New enemy - Troll[/h3][/b]
What is it - it has two legs, pointy ears, smells horrible, and you wouldn't entrust your pet to its care? No, it's not a green-clad boy rescuing a princess. [b]It's a nasty troll lurking for fresh meat, [/b]inattentively straying near his lair. Just look at this monstrosity. It's probably time to show him that treating poor animals like this doesn't seem right. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d82af1487ef059090674bc53069b9c4c76b038c5.png[/img]

That's all for today, and we're back to making the game. Let us know what you think of the above features, and don't forget to join our Discord - it's a smug place for RPG & coffee lovers (but if you are more of a tea person, you are more than welcome too.) 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/k3fPxX8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/329fdb66137bcd2c299ca4d231619a03b531062d.png[/img][/url]


Stay tuned,
Zoria Team
